title: Sample 15s Storyboard
idea: 최첨단 스마트워치의 아침 일상을 세련되게 표현해줘.
global_grid_prompt: A cinematic 3x3 grid sheet showing a young professional with a smartwatch in a modern apartment, 9 different camera angles (ECU, CU, MS, OTS, Full, Low, High, Profile, Wide), cinematic, consistent look, no text, no borders.

scenes.content_kr: 햇살이 침실 창으로 부드럽게 들어오는 아침 풍경
scenes.image_prompt_en: Soft morning sunlight streaming through bedroom curtains, cinematic warm tones, 4k.

scenes.content_kr: 스마트워치가 손목 위에서 알람으로 살짝 진동
scenes.image_prompt_en: Close-up of a smartwatch on a wrist, subtle haptic vibration, soft bokeh background.
Young professional smiling while waking up, natural light, lifestyle cinematic shot.
Smartwatch screen showing daily schedule UI, sharp clear display, modern design.

scenes.content_kr: 따뜻한 커피잔과 손목 위 시계의 클로즈업
scenes.image_prompt_en: Cinematic close-up of coffee cup and smartwatch, shallow depth of field, warm tones.
Hand tapping smartwatch to play music while stepping outside, urban morning street.
Dynamic running shot, smartwatch heart rate display visible, cinematic motion blur.

scenes.content_kr: 성취감 있는 미소와 함께 도시 전경을 바라보는 모습
scenes.image_prompt_en: Wide cinematic shot of a person overlooking the cityscape with a satisfied smile, golden hour.

scenes.content_kr: 제품 로고와 슬로건이 떠오르는 마무리 컷
scenes.image_prompt_en: Product logo emerging on a clean dark background with subtle particle effects, cinematic finale.
